writableState.name: logs
writableState.rollback: Preserve the journal. The application has no release-local writable state or database migrations.

privateConfiguration: SMTP credentials and both protected host environment files remain outside immutable artifacts. Contact submissions, caches, queues, and other writable state are never packaged.
topology: One compiled Node process serves static output and the contact API on 127.0.0.1:3007 behind the existing Nginx IPv4 and IPv6 listeners. Preserve the installed service identity, environment files, Nginx policy, certificates, and port.
